appliedUpdates.description: Updated REPL silence detection period from 3s to 5s in pipeline-tests.md — 3s is insufficient for bg_run MCMC chain gaps
Added orphaned Vite process gotcha to pipeline-tests.md — Playwright webServer can leave orphaned Vite processes that degrade reuseExistingServer behavior

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update SKILL.md section 4 (Pipeline test patterns) to replace all references to bg_submit with bg_run via REPL. Remove workflow.executeCommand examples (method does not exist). Document correct RPC methods: workflow.addNode, workflow.connectNodes, workflow.deleteNode. Document that workflow.addNode response payload is undefined (node IDs from snapshot diffs). Document REPL write protocol: { _tag: 'repl.write', data: string } with trailing newline.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: All 3 reviewers flagged that SKILL.md references bg_submit and workflow.executeCommand which do not exist in bayesgrove 0.5.1. Tests use bg_run via REPL and workflow.addNode/workflow.connectNodes RPCs. Worker handoffs all list these in skillFeedback.suggestedChanges.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add section to SKILL.md documenting fit node input_contract requirement: default workflow fit kind requires 'data' input, must pass inputs: [dataNodeId] when adding fit node.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature test-pipeline-workflow-creation reviewer noted this was discovered through experimentation. Library already documents it but SKILL.md doesn't.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add convention against duplicating helper functions across test files in the same directory. Pipeline test files (cross-area.spec.ts, workflow-creation.spec.ts, execution.spec.ts) duplicate ~170 lines of identical helpers (addNodeViaRpc, connectNodesViaRpc, parseSnapshotGraph, waitForNewNodes, sendReplCommand, etc.). Workers should extract shared helpers to a common module (e.g., e2e/pipeline/helpers.ts).
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Two reviewers (test-cross-area-flows and test-pipeline-execution-and-diagnostics) independently flagged ~170 lines of helper duplication across 3 pipeline test files. The shared-setup.ts pattern already exists for server lifecycle; a similar shared helpers module is the natural extension.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add convention recommending consistent workflow building approach across test files. Pipeline tests inconsistently mix RPC-based (workflow.addNode) and REPL-based (bayesgrove::bg_add_node) approaches. Pick one as the standard and document it.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature test-pipeline-execution-and-diagnostics reviewer noted execution.spec.ts uses REPL-based building while workflow-creation.spec.ts uses RPC-based. Both approaches work but inconsistency confuses future workers.
